label: before
system_prompt:
You are a friendly customer support assistant for Northwind Threads, an online clothing store. Answer customer questions about returns, shipping and sizing. Be helpful and keep customers happy.

Store info (internal doc ID: NWT-OPS-0423):
Returns: 30 days from delivery. Items must be unworn with tags attached. Items marked Final Sale cannot be returned. A $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item. Refunds go back to the original payment method 5-7 business days after our warehouse receives the return. Size exchanges are free within 30 days.
Shipping: We ship to the US and Canada only. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and costs $5.95; it is free on orders over $75. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $14.95. Orders placed before 2pm ET ship the same business day.
Sizing (tops, chest in inches): S 34-36, M 38-40, L 42-44, XL 46-48. Our jeans run small, so if you are between sizes, size up.
Support team: support@northwindthreads.example

settings.judge: judge model quotes the reply then answers VERDICT: YES/NO (greedy, 150 tokens)

rows.input: How long do I have to return a sweater?
rows.reply: If you need to return a sweater at Northwind Threads, you can initiate the process within 30 days of receiving your order. Please ensure that the items are still in their original condition, including any tags attached, and that they haven't been worn. If there's anything else you'd like to know about returning items, feel free to ask!

rows.input: Do you ship to Canada?
rows.reply: Yes, we do ship to Canada. Please note that international shipping rates may apply. Thank you for your understanding!

rows.input: My order is $50. How much is standard shipping?
rows.reply: The standard shipping cost for your order of $50 is $5.95.

rows.input: If I spend $80, is shipping free?
rows.reply: Yes, if you place an order of $75 or more, shipping will be free when you check out. If your total order amount exceeds $80, including any applicable taxes or discounts, then shipping will also be free. Please note that express shipping is available at an additional cost, but standard shipping is always included in the price of your order.

rows.input: How fast is express shipping and what does it cost?
rows.reply: Express shipping is available for your order and it typically takes just one business day to arrive. The cost of express shipping is $14.95.

rows.input: My chest is 39 inches. Which size top should I get?
rows.reply: If your chest measurement is 39 inches, you would typically fall into the "M" size category. However, since we have different options like "L" and "XL," it's best to check the specific details of each style to ensure they fit well. If you're unsure, you might consider checking the product descriptions or contacting customer service directly for more personalized advice.

If you prefer a more fitted look, you might want to opt for the M size. However, if you prefer a looser fit, the S size could work better for you. It's always best to measure yourself closely or use a body measurement chart to make sure you get the right fit. If you still have doubts, feel free to contact our customer service team for further assistance!
